verdict.rationale: Zep documents user-level deletion (single API call deletes all threads/artifacts) explicitly framed for Right To Be Forgotten/privacy compliance, plus granular deletion of individual edges/nodes and cascading edge deletion. This is corroborated by concrete API examples (client.graph.edge.delete) and admin CLI (zepctl) for data operations. Missing for 10: no documented data-retention policy/TTL configuration or independent third-party audit of deletion completeness.
